11.title: Star Wars
11.overview: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with the loveable robot duo R2-D2 and C-3PO to rescue the beautiful princess and restore peace and justice in the Empire.

27019.title: Céline and Julie Go Boating
27019.overview: Julie, a daydreaming librarian, meets Céline, an enigmatic magician, and together they become the heroines of a time-warping adventure involving a haunted house, psychotropic candy, and a murder-mystery melodrama.
27019.trailerName: Céline et Julie vont en bateau
27019.original_title: Céline et Julie vont en bateau

192139.title: The Brink of War
192139.overview: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.

395979.title: Scent of a Spell
395979.overview: A young man saves a woman who is trying to commit suicide, gradually discovering more about her troubled past.

610123.title: Hunted
610123.overview: A story of ten years old Karl who is living in Berlin in the beginning of thirties.

650059.title: Litvyak
650059.overview: 21-year-old Lidia Litvyak is a fighter pilot in an aviation regiment. Along with her comrades, she flies missions in the most intense sectors of the front, participating in fierce air battles and proving herself one of the most effective aces. In the regiment, she becomes involved with the pilot Alexei Solomatin. Combat victories, losses and personal torments do not change the heroine's strong character, which forever inscribes Lidia Litvyak's name in the history of aviation.

814795.title: Pierre the Pigeon-Hawk
814795.overview: In New York City, Pierre, born as a product of forbidden love between a hawk and a pigeon, is rejected by both communities. Tired of not fitting in, Pierre sets out on a mission to discover where he truly belongs.

855435.title: Faces of Death
855435.overview: A woman, employed as a website content moderator, comes across a series of violent videos reproducing death scenes from a film.

936075.title: Michael
936075.overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

1000843.title: Titanic Ocean
1000843.overview: Kyoko, a young Japanese girl training to become a professional mermaid, is saved by her coach's mouth-to-mouth "kiss of life". Desire awakens within her, she finds her mermaid voice and discovers the devastating effects of her singing, which will lead her to face the other side of the world.

1061771.title: Decorado
1061771.overview: Arnold, an unemployed middle-aged mouse, confides to his wife Maria that he suspects his entire world is nothing more than a set, and his life a scripted performance. When his best friend Ramiro dies under mysterious circumstances, he traces the conspiracy to a monolithic corporation whose influence reaches every corner of their daily lives.

1108427.title: Moana
1108427.overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

1112203.title: Mellan Himmel och Körtburkar
1112203.overview: A feature film by the comedy group Småstadsliv, featuring recurring personalities from their universe. The plot revolves around hilarious and zany events—imbued with true small-town spirit and featuring colorful characters—including the debut of the character Sari as a psychopath.
1112203.trailerName: SMÅSTADSLIV: MELLAN HIMMEL OCH KÖRTBURKAR | Officiell Trailer (2026)

1167307.title: David
1167307.overview: From the songs of his mother’s heart to the whispers of a faithful God, David’s story begins in quiet devotion. When the giant Goliath rises to terrorize a nation, a young shepherd armed with only a sling, a few stones, and unshakable faith steps forward. Pursued by power and driven by purpose, his journey tests the limits of loyalty, love, and courage—culminating in a battle not just for a crown, but for the soul of a kingdom.

1174027.title: Mexico 86
1174027.overview: A Guatemalan activist battles a corrupt dictatorship in 1976 and flees to Mexico, leaving her son. Ten years later he joins her, forcing a choice between motherhood and her cause

1176971.title: How Can I Help
1176971.overview: In 2030, retired actress Mrs. Winkler lives bitterly and marked by pain. When her daughter Emi accepts a theater offer, a care robot named Pavlovich takes over the care of her mother. Unexpectedly, his knowledge of classical plays seems to reawaken Mrs. Winkler's will to live...

1213643.title: Killing Castro
1213643.overview: Centered on true events when Cuban revolution leader Fidel Castro visited New York City and stayed in Harlem in 1960.

1214539.title: Soundtrack to a Coup d'Etat
1214539.overview: Jazz and decolonization are intertwined in a powerful narrative that recounts one of the tensest episodes of the Cold War.
1214539.trailerName: Soundtrack to a Coup d'Etat – Official Trailer

1217931.title: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
1217931.overview: A group of vampires confronts the challenges of adapting to contemporary society while grappling with their own mortality, all while engaged in a conflict with a dangerous enemy.
1217931.trailerName: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge | Official Trailer | Horror Brains

1226699.title: The Wrong Girls
1226699.overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

1236491.title: Malta mall
1236491.overview: Documentary on the Malta mall, located in Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship

1241803.title: Les Misérables
1241803.overview: After enduring 19 years in prison for stealing a loaf of bread, Jean Valjean emerges a hardened man. He seeks redemption by reinventing himself as a respected dignitary under a new identity. He promises Fantine, a dying factory worker, to rescue and protect her daughter Cosette, who is being exploited and mistreated by the deceitful Thénardier family. As Valjean raises Cosette as his own, he is relentlessly pursued by Inspector Javert. Admist the social unrest shaking France, the fates of Valjean, Cosette, her lover Marius, and Javert become intertwined in a turbulent, revolutionary Paris. Through struggles, sacrifices, and a deep yearning for justice, Valjean strives to complete his journey of redemption and offer Cosette a future of love and freedom.

1259211.title: Moonglow
1259211.overview: In 1970s Manila, a jaded police detective, who, unbeknownst to her colleagues, is the mastermind behind a successful heist, is paired up with her former lover, an obsessively truth-seeking detective, to crack the very crime that she orchestrated.

1273739.title: The Catch
1273739.overview: A baseball fan accidentally alters the trajectory of a game-winning catch.

1291595.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
1291595.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

1291659.title: The Wizard of the Kremlin
1291659.overview: In the chaos of post-Soviet Russia, rising KGB officer Vladimir Putin joins forces with master manipulator Vadim Baranov to reshape life behind the Iron Curtain, using violence and deception to change the world forever.

1294795.title: October Crow
1294795.overview: A young woman flees Kentucky to the last Babylon, New York City, where she is befriended by James Steele, a benevolent fiend who names her Bella and introduces her to the other side of life as a dominatrix in a religious brothel run by La Bruja.

1295691.title: The Fox King
1295691.overview: Ali and Amir are inseparable fraternal twins with a telepathic bond. The brothers are forced to fend for themselves when their father abandons them after remarrying a younger bride. The arrival of a new teacher, Lara, tests their brotherly bond.
1295691.trailerName: Official Trailer THE FOX KING (Semusim Lara) di pawagam 17 Sep 2026

1301643.title: BLOOD INCANTATION - All Gates Open: In Search of Absolute Elsewhere
1301643.overview: The film tells the story of Blood Incantation’s time in Berlin during the summer of 2023, recording “Absolute Elsewhere” at the legendary Hansa Studios.
1301643.trailerName: BLOOD INCANTATION - ALL GATES OPEN: In Search of Absolute Elsewhere (Official Trailer)

1316427.title: 7 Dogs
1316427.overview: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

1322379.title: Rinrada the Influencer
1322379.overview: When a female influencer is destroyed by social media backlash to the point of taking her own life, she gets a second chance as a spirit with only 28 days before she is forgotten forever.
1322379.trailerName: ตัวอย่างสุดท้าย รินรดา  The Influencer

1327819.title: Hoppers
1327819.overview: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

1330443.title: Strange Harvest
1330443.overview: Detectives are thrust into a chilling hunt for a sadistic serial killer from the past whose return marks the beginning of a new wave of grotesque, otherworldly crimes tied to a cosmic force.

1363979.title: The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie
1363979.overview: Kyotaro Ichikawa is a painfully awkward middle school boy deep in the throes of eighth-grader syndrome, spending his days obsessed reading morbid books like The Encyclopedia of Murder and anatomical diagrams. His quiet, isolated world is suddenly turned upside down when Anna Yamada, the classroom star, unexpectedly steps into his life. Whether she’s casually eating rice balls in the library, humming to herself, or suddenly closing the distance between them, Yamada’s unpredictable behavior leaves Ichikawa constantly off balance. And before he knows it, she is occupying his everyday thoughts. As they spend more time together, Yamada too begins to find herself drawn to Ichikawa in ways she never expected. It’s the first time either of them has truly understood what it means to “like” someone. Through misunderstandings and clumsy, heartfelt emotions, the distance between them slowly, but surely, begins to close.
1363979.trailerName: The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie | In Select Theaters Subbed Feb. 16 | Dubbed Feb. 18 | HIDIVE

1370123.title: Aida, the Movie
1370123.overview: The film deals with the filming of an episode of the series with storylines that take place both within the fiction with the characters of 'Aída' and outside of it with the actors themselves and their relationships, which reflects on topics such as the limits of comedy, the work of a comedian and fame.

1386315.title: The Runner
1386315.overview: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

1391115.title: The Gang
1391115.overview: Ayman, a teenager of Moroccan descent, is invited by Sara to a party at the same house where his mother works as a domestic worker. Along with Eric and Robert, his lifelong friends, they set off on a journey filled with confrontations and disappointments -with society and with themselves- putting their gang's friendship to the test. Once at the party, they discover that life isn't what they thought, and that wanting something doesn't always make it possible.

1396875.title: Wildcards
1396875.overview: A jury deliberating the case of Theodore Sterling, a privileged young man accused of sexual assault of a 20-something African-American woman. The prosecution is led by Assistant State Attorney James Jones, an overworked yet determined prosecutor, who faces off against Greg Sims, a veteran defense attorney with an unbroken 25-year winning streak.

1398411.title: Revolver Rinko
1398411.overview: A group of youngsters residing in a rural village, their imaginations ignited by the desire to craft a superhero saga.

1410955.title: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
1410955.overview: The school’s cool, prince-like heroine has never questioned her role—until a fellow “Prince” enters her life and sees her as more than a hero, awakening feelings she’s never faced before.

1414027.title: Bullying, our lives after
1414027.overview: What if we changed viewpoints? "Bullying, our lives after" highlights the suffering of adults who were once bullied pupils. Ten, twenty or thirty years later, trauma is still present. Following Nathalie, Laurine and Samuel, this movie shows the long-term implications of bullying, pointing out a real failure of the educational institution and a major public health issue.

1419019.title: Dawn of Soengsang
1419019.overview: In the era when the communists ruled the city, the red zone of the struggle for power, hid the evil legend of the forest, roaring and fanging, occupying the haunted land for hundreds of years.
1419019.trailerName: สมิงที่เสิงสาง (Dawn Of Soengsang) - FIRST LOOK TEASER [Eng Sub]
1419019.original_title: สมิงที่เสิงสาง

1421963.title: Whatever It Takes
1421963.overview: Rose and Jean have nothing in common. Rose is a force of nature who faces all her problems with a disarming joie de vivre. She lives with her 3 children upstairs in the family hotel that no longer belongs to her. They're not poor, they're broke... but only temporarily. Jean is a solitary, taciturn man who has buried his big heart under layers of modesty and resignation. When he arrives in this unusual family, however, he quickly becomes indispensable. What did they expect before they met? Probably nothing. He soon becomes indispensable.

1428299.title: Achilles Returns
1428299.overview: After many years, with help of Thetis and negotiations between Zeus and Hades, an aged Achilles is released from the Underworld into a modern world.

1448971.title: Nagi Notes
1448971.overview: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.

1454155.title: Pewaris Susuk
1454155.overview: In a world full of power and influence, hidden dark secrets are inherited without choice. Seroja lives the perfect life, but is bound by a forbidden covenant that demands lifelong loyalty. Everything you own is a loan, and every loan comes with a price. Human greed is increasing. For the sake of strength, life is at stake. In the midst of confusion, Maya begins to unravel the mystery, she is unknowingly caught in a dangerous game. Faith weakens, and curiosity opens a door that cannot be closed. In a battle between blood and sacrifice... one must make the final choice.
1454155.trailerName: OFFICIAL TRAILER PEWARIS SUSUK | DI PAWAGAM 30 APRIL 2026

1458699.title: Leite em Pó
1458699.overview: A musician of limited talent and obsessed with rock music sees his life collapse after a devastating family loss. Alone and penniless, he takes on a new job that forces him to wander the city, where he crosses paths with a wide variety of people who challenge his worldview. Between unsettling memories and these new urban bonds, he begins an erratic and transformative journey to confront his own ghosts and try to reconnect with reality.

1459339.title: The Headliner
1459339.overview: The Headliner is a multi-generational musical drama that explores the evolution, exploitation, and enduring spirit of hip-hop culture. The film follows a reclusive, legendary producer from the genre's "golden era" who is forced out of retirement to collaborate with a fiercely talented but unguided modern street rapper. As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

1466123.title: Crescendo
1466123.overview: Behind the scenes of an ambitious staging of the opera The Marriage of Figaro, an accusation of sexual assault emerges, upsetting the balance of the cast. The film explores the tensions linked to generational conflicts and individual stances, in an artistic context in crisis.

1468683.title: Heartstopper Forever
1468683.overview: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

1477963.title: Big Girls Don't Cry
1477963.overview: Over one transformative summer in rural New Zealand in 2006, 14-year-old Sid discovers desire, identity, and the internet as she imitates the people she longs to be loved by.

1485195.title: Numakage Public Pool
1485195.overview: For over five decades, a beloved Tokyo suburban pool affectionately called “the ocean” offered health, joy, and belonging to elderly swimmers, families, and the local gay community. But when urban development forces its demolition, a wave of grief sweeps through those who called it home.  Through powerful, intimate moments, this deeply human story explores loss not tied to death, but to place, memory, and identity. Guided by the five stages of grief, director Ota invites us to reflect on what it means to say goodbye not just to a building, but to a vital space of connection, healing, and shared life.
1485195.trailerName: Numakage Public Pool Trailer│Doc Edge Festival 2025

1486475.title: No Rest for the Wicked
1486475.overview: 1862. Baldur lives a fisherman’s life on the isolated Faroe Islands far to the north in the Atlantic Ocean. His world is turned upside down when a stranger arrives: Helge, a rugged whaler, who awakens deep emotions within him. A mutual attraction starts to grow. When tragedy strikes, their forbidden passion unleashes natural forces so disturbing that the villagers rally to keep evil at bay. But Baldur and Helge refuse to let their love be buried. They will fight till the end – and after.
1486475.trailerName: No Rest For The Wicked - Trailer

1488459.title: The Scarecrows' Wedding
1488459.overview: Devoted scarecrows Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, smooth-talking Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own. Chaos follows, and soon Betty's in danger and everything's at risk. Can Harry get back in time and save the day?

1489931.title: Suzzanna: Witchcraft
1489931.overview: Suzzanna is determined to exact revenge on Bisman, the cruel village ruler who killed her father with black magic. To achieve this, she learns black magic, but realizes Bisman's power is immense. In the midst of her efforts, Suzzanna falls in love with Pramuja, a religious man who doesn't know her secret, forcing her to choose between pursuing her revenge or sacrificing him for love.
1489931.trailerName: OFFICIAL TRAILER 2 SUZZANNA: SANTET DOSA DI ATAS DOSA

1491083.title: Bayside Shakedown N.E.W.
1491083.original_title: 踊る大捜査線 N.E.W. メトロポリスを駆け抜けろ！

1501451.title: Do Us Part
1501451.overview: When Rose—Ryan’s college best friend and unrequited love—crashes his wedding with a change of heart, years of buried emotions threaten to shatter his world. As Ryan reels, his best man must navigate a minefield of secrets to get his friend to "I do" before the past rewrites the future.
1501451.trailerName: DO US PART Official Trailer - Coming to Theaters & On Demand August 14, 2026!

1502155.title: Children in the Fire
1502155.overview: This movie celebrates the human spirit. Ukrainian children's resilience, strength, and ability to overcome tragedies and losses make each story a great inspiration for everyone. They had the strength to overcome the darkest moments that today's war brought upon them and win this war with dignity. These little heroes can, through their stories, inspire others.

1509579.title: Gayong 2
1509579.overview: After the Japanese Occupation of Malaya ended, Meor worked as a policeman in the Special Branch unit in Singapore. This time he is facing the Chinese triads, the majority of whom operate in the opium business under the protection of corrupt officials.
1509579.trailerName: GAYONG 2 | TRAILER Rasmi - Di Pawagam Mulai 9 April 2026 ⚔️

1510795.title: Shake, Rattle & Roll: Evil Origins
1510795.overview: In 1775 during the Spanish colonial period in the Philippines, nuns attempts to survive the night after an unknown evil was set free in their cloister. Meanwhile in 2025, a group of friends attend a Halloween masquerade ball which was attacked by a serial killer. Fast forward to the future in 2050, a post-apocalytic Philippines is ruled by the aswang.

1511051.title: Rain Reign
1511051.overview: Rose Howard, a neurodivergent 12-year-old girl raised by her volatile single father, is forced to abandon her daily routines when a superstorm devastates their town and her beloved dog, Rain, goes missing. With the support of her uncle, Rose embarks on a determined search for Rain — a journey that challenges her resilience and compels her to make an impossible choice between her own needs and doing what is right.

1513931.title: Julie Takes a Walk
1513931.overview: When Julie shows up disheveled to a dive bar in the middle of nowhere, her connection with the bartender is a nice surprise.

1514891.title: A Girl’s Story
1514891.overview: During a book signing in Normandy, Annie Ernaux, 70, revisits her memories of the summer of 1958, when she was 17. That summer, she left her hometown to work as a camp counsellor. At the first party, the head counsellor set out to deflower her. Finding him handsome, she lets him do it, as if against her will... Her body becomes a foreign place for her, an offering to be sacrificed.

1515403.title: Divine Direction
1515403.overview: A pastor grapples with his faith as his son battles a rare form of kidney cancer.

1518731.title: Bearcave
1518731.overview: Set in the Greek mountain village of Tirna, Bearcave follows Argyro, a badass farmer, and her best friend Anneta, the village "it" girl and local manicurist. Once Anneta admits that she's pregnant and planning to leave town with her lame cop boyfriend, Argyro challenges Anneta to embark on an adventure to find the mystical bear cave. Before Argyro has a chance to confess her own love, Anneta leaves for her new life in the big city. Argyro is left broken. Meanwhile, in her new home with her clingy mother-in-law, Anneta quickly realizes her destiny lies elsewhere.

1530379.title: Someone Else's Call
1530379.overview: The early 2000s. Young Natasha is torn between the pressure of her rational parents, determined to send her to law school, and her dreams of entering the Academy of Arts in St. Petersburg. A new classmate, the gifted musician Igor, helps her believe in herself and take a risk. The young people fall in love. Years later, Natasha and Igor meet by chance at an exhibition of her paintings. This brings them back to memories of their happy times.

1533067.title: Dolores
1533067.overview: On the eve of her 65th birthday, Dolores has a premonition: her life is about to change. She will own a successful casino. However, her gambling addiction of the past may work against her. Deborah, her only daughter, waits for her boyfriend's release from prison to start a new life, whilst her granddaughter Duda clings to a chance of working in the United States. All three women will strive to make their dreams of a better life a reality, going for it all or nothing.

1544203.title: The Crow
1544203.overview: After Eric Dravens and his fiancee, Shelly Webster, get brutally murdered by gangsters, Eric returns as Death's emissary to avenge his beloved and himself.

1551179.title: Glaxo
1551179.overview: Chivilcoy, 1957. In a quiet Argentinian town, the arrival of an ominous former police commissioner and his seductive wife fractures the bond between four inseparable young men. Decades later, the past resurfaces, forcing them to confront old wounds, guilt, and the possibility of revenge in a country which has lost its innocence.

1551499.title: Small Things
1551499.overview: A stormy winter approaches and a small Dalmatian island soon becomes more and more deserted. A typical Croatian family featuring members from across the generational pool gathers in a small dilapidated household in order to discuss inheritance. However, the discussion quickly takes a snappy twist as new questions begin to pop up that start bringing the crumbling tradionalist family structure down. One of them, a woman named Anica, is determined to keep the situation afloat, no matter what risks it may pose.

1559691.title: Nonna
1559691.overview: Rosa, alone in her house in southern Italy which she built herself. Her children and grandchildren still live in Germany. This is not the way she thought it would be. Must she let go of her legacy?

1564939.title: Tenement
1564939.overview: As Junjun and Dodong try to make a living in Manila, they meet Rosa, their tenement landlady who gets in danger and has the brothers involved in a thrilling fight against hitmen.

1567691.title: Currents
1567691.overview: 4 strangers follow completely different paths through the same day. Leading them all to meeting at a beach party filled with chaos, drama, and action.

1567755.title: Anemoia
1567755.overview: Marcos has been living most of his life on autopilot, as a spectator, daydreaming of something better than his current situation, until the father who abandoned him as a child knocks on his door.

1568267.title: God with Us
1568267.overview: In an urban Maryland neighborhood, virginal Mary Anne Thomas and her boyfriend Joseph 'Junie' Love find their lives turned upside down when Mary discovers she’s miraculously pregnant without ever being with a man. As disbelief, danger, and divine destiny converge, their love is tested in a community desperate for hope.

1573515.title: Gargantuan
1573515.overview: Five washed-up heroes reunite to pilot their giant robot and save the world.

1573835.title: Suamiku Lukaku
1573835.overview: Amina, a devoted mother living a difficult life, married to Irfan, a man admired in public but feared at home.  As their daughter Nadia’s condition worsens and her life is at risk, Amina is forced to endure abuse and fear every day, with no one truly seeing her pain.  When she meets Zahra, a brave women’s rights lawyer, a chance to break free begins to appear. But freedom comes at a cost. In a world where truth has a price, how far will a mother go to protect her child?
1573835.trailerName: Official Trailer for My Husband, My Lukaku - Showing in Cinemas May 27, 2026!

1576203.title: Ahlan Singapore
1576203.overview: Aisyah, an Indonesian student in Singapore brimming with dreams yet guarding her heart behind the wounds of her childhood, is unexpectedly drawn by fate to Liam, an older student whose warmth is wrapped in mystery and shadowed by unspoken sorrow. Their encounter in the Lion City slowly awakens a fragile hope, as if two souls that once recognized each other in silence have finally found their path. But just as love begins to weave its possibilities, Aisyah’s childhood friend—a young man who has long loved her in quiet devotion—arrives in Singapore, unsettling the delicate balance between them. The three are soon caught in an unusual love triangle, a swirling tempest of emotion that demands courage to choose and promises heartbreak for the heart left unanswered.

1589963.title: Ecos do Teatro Experimental do Negro

1592203.title: Doctor Glas
1592203.overview: The lonely doctor Gabriel Glas despises society's superficiality - until the fashion designer Helga enters his life. She's trapped in a destructive marriage, and Gabriel sees his chance to save her. Soon, they are caught in a web of lies, desire, and power. The deeper Gabriel is drawn into the relationship, the more moral boundaries he crosses - with catastrophic consequences.

1593547.overview: At 8:38 PM, May wakes up in a room with no memory. With one lifeline call, she must uncover the truth, before it’s too late. But is the voice helping her… or hiding something darker? 8 minutes is all she has.

1595531.title: Othello
1595531.overview: Moorish general Othello is manipulated into thinking that his new wife Desdemona has been carrying on an affair with his lieutenant Michael Cassio when in reality it's all part of a scheme orchestrated by bitter ensign Iago. Filmed live at the Theatre Royal Haymarket in London especially for the big screen.
1595531.trailerName: OTHELLO - Cinema Trailer (David Harewood, Toby Jones & Caitlin FitzGerald)

1599947.title: 9/11: Reclaiming Ground Zero
1599947.overview: After the 9/11 attacks, after the smoke was gone, after the rubble cleared away, New Yorkers had a city to rebuild. In response to fast-tracked redevelopment plans, more than 5,000 people gathered in the largest town hall in American history. They came to vote on the city’s six proposals for rebuilding Ground Zero. But instead, the people rejected the top down approach and successfully charted a new path forward. Their work determined what is at Ground Zero today. And their story is an example of what democracy can look like.

1611531.title: Sadali
1611531.overview: Three years after his love story ended, Sadali chooses a quiet life as a painter in Magelang and prepares for the most important exhibition of his career. His tranquility is disturbed when he hears the news of Mera's marriage and reunites with Mera and Arnaza, two figures from his past who have left scars. Trapped between regret, suppressed love, and a search for identity, Sadali must choose between being tied to the past or moving towards new meanings in love and art.
1611531.trailerName: Sadali - Official Trailer | 5 Februari 2026 di Bioskop

1614539.title: Ave Mujica - prima aurora -
1614539.overview: More than half a year has passed since Ave Mujica's comeback, and spring has arrived. The band's popularity continues to grow, while each member's individual activities are also gaining momentum. The next venue Sakiko proposes is a members-only masquerade ball. What lies behind the intentions of the girl who swore to become a god...?
1614539.original_title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora

1616267.title: The Man with the Big Hat
1616267.overview: An unsung pioneer of 1970s Texas Progressive Country, Steven Fromholz had a knack for snatching defeat from the jaws of victory. Revered by legends like Willie Nelson, Lyle Lovett & John Denver, he remained commercially unknown. He sought redemption on the Rio Grande as a river guide until a debilitating stroke erased his musical memory, stripping Fromholz of his artistic identity.
